purpose: Certify final endpoint equilibrium and conservative rest-to-rest time reachability without relying on a feedback controller gain choice.

method.endpoint: bounded nonlinear least-squares equilibrium over five joint angles, roll, pitch, and the canonical four-axis wrench; residual is the frozen MuJoCo generalized acceleration under the case final wind
method.target_constraint: translate the free base so the frozen cutter-tip site equals the exact final target
method.time_certificate: rest-to-rest bang-bang lower-bound using 1.0 m/s^2 conservative translational authority plus two longest-link pendulum periods
method.wind: exact final frozen Development wind sample through the frozen distributed aerodynamic model
